analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (1,183,000 KRW) above SMA5 (1,152,200 KRW), below SMA20 (1,281,300 KRW), and below SMA50 (1,504,380 KRW): short-term trend weakening, mid-term trend declining.
· Significantly below SMA100 (1,673,662 KRW) and SMA200 (1,526,631 KRW): long-term trend weak.
· 52-week position at 27.4% + current price level is high relative to 52-week low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 42.0 → 41.4 (staying neutral): confirming lack of directional momentum.
· MACD histogram -220.5584 → -1266.0973 (worsening): strengthening bearish signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position near the middle band (1,281,300 KRW): confirming sideways range.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support at 1,171,000 KRW: limiting downside from 5-day low.
· Swing resistance at 1,587,000 KRW: 20-day high level, potential trend reversal upon breakout.
· Mismatch in 5-day and 20-day high/low patterns: weak trend formation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio 0.78: declining confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: Accumulation phase: maintain wait-and-see until directional confirmation.
